From \"the right answer\" to a distribut.src: From "the right answer" to a distribution over answers

Maximum likelihood gives you one number.zh: 最大似然为未知参数 $\theta$ 给出一个数字——即与数据最为相符的那个取值。贝叶斯方案则认为：数据并不挑出单个 $\theta$，而是更新你对所有可能取值的@@T0@@信念@@T1@@。这一信念是一个概率分布；更新它的配方只有一行数学：
Maximum likelihood gives you one number.src: Maximum likelihood gives you one number for an unknown parameter $\theta$ — the value most consistent with the data. The Bayesian alternative says: the data don't pick a single $\theta$, they update your belief over all possible values. That belief is a probability distribution; the recipe for updating it is one line of math:

Three ingredients: the\n @@T0@@.zh: 三种成分：@@T0@@先验 $p(\theta)$@@T1@@（你此前所持的信念）、@@T2@@似然 $p(\mathcal{D}\mid\theta)$@@T3@@（数据如何依赖于 $\theta$），以及@@T4@@后验 $p(\theta \mid \mathcal{D})$@@T5@@（你更新后的信念）。分母只是一个使后验积分为 1 的归一化常数；我们大多会忽略它。
Three ingredients: the\n @@T0@@.src: Three ingredients: the prior $p(\theta)$ (what you believed before), the likelihood $p(\mathcal{D}\mid\theta)$ (how the data depend on $\theta$), and the posterior $p(\theta \mid \mathcal{D})$ (your updated belief). The denominator is just a normalising constant that makes the posterior integrate to 1; we'll mostly ignore it.

Two clean consequences. First, posterior.zh: 有两个清晰的推论。第一，后验方差按 $1/n$ 下降——这正是经典的“数据锐化信念”，但有了一个有原则的速率。第二，先验贡献了固定数量的伪数据：当 $\sigma=1$ 时，一个 $\sigma_0 = 0.1$ 的紧致先验“相当于” $\sigma^2 / \sigma_0^2 = 100$ 个数据点。
Two clean consequences. First, posterior.src:
Two clean consequences. First, posterior variance falls like
          $1/n$ — classical "data sharpens beliefs" but with a
          principled rate. Second, the prior contributes a fixed amount
          of pseudo-data: a tight prior with $\sigma_0 = 0.1$ is "worth"
          $\sigma^2 / \sigma_0^2 = 100$ data points for $\sigma=1$.

Posterior std vs sample size for three p.src: Posterior std vs sample size for three prior strengths. Theory line is $\sigma_n = (\tau_0 + n/\sigma^2)^{-1/2}$.

@@T0@@Why Beta(1, 1) is uniform.@@T1@@ S.zh:
@@T0@@为何 Beta(1, 1) 是均匀分布。@@T1@@ 令 $\alpha = \beta = 1$
          得到 [0,1] 上的平坦先验：每一种硬币偏置在事前都等可能。在此先验下，$n$ 次抛掷中出现 $k$ 次正面后的后验均值为 $(k+1)/(n+2)$——即 Laplace 的成功法则。@@T2@@这@@T3@@正是你的统计老师含糊解释过的、为何在小样本概率中给分子加 1、给分母加 2 的原因。
@@T0@@Why Beta(1, 1) is uniform.@@T1@@ S.src: Why Beta(1, 1) is uniform. Setting $\alpha = \beta = 1$ gives the flat prior on [0,1]: every coin bias is a priori equally likely. With this prior the posterior mean after $k$ heads in $n$ flips is $(k+1)/(n+2)$ — Laplace's rule of succession. That is what your stats teacher mumbled about why we add 1 to the numerator and 2 to the denominator in small-sample probabilities.

Posterior predictive ≠ plug-in MAP.zh: 后验预测分布 ≠ 代入式 MAP

The posterior is the right object for th.zh: 后验是关于参数的正确对象。但在下游我们通常关心的是预测@@T0@@新数据@@T1@@。有两种做法：
The posterior is the right object for th.src: The posterior is the right object for the parameter. But downstream we usually care about predicting new data. There are two ways to do that:

@@T0@@Plug-in MAP / MLE.@@T1@@ Pick one.zh: @@T0@@代入式 MAP / MLE。@@T1@@ 挑选一个 $\theta$（最大值处），并预测 $p(x_{\text{new}}\mid\hat\theta)$。
@@T0@@Plug-in MAP / MLE.@@T1@@ Pick one.src: Plug-in MAP / MLE. Pick one $\theta$ (the maximum) and predict $p(x_{\text{new}}\mid\hat\theta)$.

@@T0@@Posterior predictive.@@T1@@ Averag.zh: @@T0@@后验预测分布。@@T1@@ 对所有 $	heta$ 按后验加权求平均：$\;p(x_{	ext{new}}\mid\mathcal{D}) = \int p(x_{	ext{new}}\mid	heta)\,p(	heta\mid\mathcal{D})\,d	heta$。
@@T0@@Posterior predictive.@@T1@@ Averag.src: Posterior predictive. Average over every $\theta$ weighted by the posterior: $\;p(x_{\text{new}}\mid\mathcal{D}) = \int p(x_{\text{new}}\mid\theta)\,p(\theta\mid\mathcal{D})\,d\theta$.

Plug-in is faster but lies about uncerta.zh: 代入式更快，但在不确定性上说了谎。只要你尚未精确知道 $\theta$，后验预测分布就会更宽——而这正是校准最为关键的区间。观察随着 $n$ 增大，这一差距如何缩小。
Plug-in is faster but lies about uncerta.src:
Plug-in is faster but lies about uncertainty. The posterior
          predictive is wider whenever you don't yet know $\theta$
          precisely — precisely the regime where calibration
          matters most. Watch the gap shrink as $n$ grows.

For the same Gaussian-Gaussian setup as.zh: 对第 1 步中同样的高斯-高斯设定，从各预测分布中抽取一个新样本：虚线 = 代入式 MAP，实线 = 完整的后验预测分布。
For the same Gaussian-Gaussian setup as.src: For the same Gaussian-Gaussian setup as Step 1 with a fresh sample drawn from the predictive distributions: dashed = plug-in MAP, solid = full posterior predictive.

@@T0@@What this costs you in practice.@@.zh:
@@T0@@这在实践中会带来什么代价。@@T1@@
          一个在类别上输出 softmax 的神经网络就是代入式的：它假装权重是固定的。当权重仍不确定时（在真实数据上，这几乎总是如此），预测分布本应更宽。这一差距表现为一个过度自信、校准失当的模型——这正是贝叶斯深度学习试图修复的缺陷。
@@T0@@What this costs you in practice.@@.src: What this costs you in practice. A neural net that outputs softmax over classes is a plug-in: it pretends the weights are fixed. When the weights are still uncertain (i.e., always, on real data), the predictive distribution should be wider. That gap shows up as an overconfident, miscalibrated model — the bug Bayesian deep learning is trying to fix.

What if the posterior isn't a nice famil.zh: 如果后验不属于一个漂亮的分布族呢？
What if the posterior isn't a nice famil.src: What if the posterior isn't a nice family?

Conjugate priors give us closed-form pos.zh: 共轭先验给了我们闭式的后验。真实的后验——来自神经网络、层次模型或非高斯似然——通常并不共轭。三类算法覆盖了全部实践：
Conjugate priors give us closed-form pos.src:
Conjugate priors give us closed-form posteriors. Real
          posteriors — from a neural net, a hierarchical model,
          a non-Gaussian likelihood — usually aren't conjugate.
          Three families of algorithms cover all of practice:

@@T0@@Grid evaluation.@@T1@@ Compute the.zh: @@T0@@网格求值。@@T1@@ 在网格上计算未归一化的后验，再归一化。精确，但在超过约 3 维后失效。
@@T0@@Grid evaluation.@@T1@@ Compute the.src: Grid evaluation. Compute the unnormalised posterior on a grid; normalise. Exact, dies above ~3 dimensions.

@@T0@@MCMC (we use Metropolis-Hastings)..zh: @@T0@@MCMC（我们使用 Metropolis-Hastings）。@@T1@@ 在 $\theta$ 上的随机游走，其分布收敛到后验。在极限意义下精确，但有限样本下有噪声。
@@T0@@MCMC (we use Metropolis-Hastings)..src: MCMC (we use Metropolis-Hastings). Random walk on $\theta$ that converges in distribution to the posterior. Exact in the limit, finite-sample-noisy.

@@T0@@Variational inference (VI).@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@变分推断（VI）。@@T1@@ 选择一个易处理的分布族（我们使用高斯分布），通过最小化与真实后验之间的 KL 散度来拟合它。快速但有偏——对多峰目标尤为如此。
@@T0@@Variational inference (VI).@@T1@@.src: Variational inference (VI). Pick a tractable family (we use a Gaussian) and fit it by minimising the KL divergence to the true posterior. Fast but biased — especially for multimodal targets.

Below: a deliberately cooked, bimodal, n.zh: 下面是一个刻意构造的双峰、非共轭后验。网格只运行一次。MCMC 链实时游走；你可以看到样本慢慢填满两个峰（或卡在其中一个）。VI 拟合则是叠加在上面的单个高斯分布——它几乎总是以一个峰为中心，而把另一个峰判断错。
Below: a deliberately cooked, bimodal, n.src:
Below: a deliberately cooked, bimodal, non-conjugate posterior.
          Grid runs once. The MCMC chain walks live; you can watch
          samples slowly fill out both modes (or get stuck in one).
          The VI fit is a single Gaussian dropped on top — almost
          always centered on one mode and miscalling the other.

Solid = true (grid) posterior. Histogram.zh: 实线 = 真实（网格）后验。直方条 = MCMC 样本。橙色虚线 = 最优拟合高斯分布（VI）。
Solid = true (grid) posterior. Histogram.src: Solid = true (grid) posterior. Histogram bars = MCMC samples. Dashed orange = best-fit Gaussian (VI).

@@T0@@Reading the picture.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@解读这幅图。@@T1@@
          网格精确但穷尽。MCMC 直方图会收敛到网格结果，但需要@@T2@@大量@@T3@@样本（以及恰当的步长：太小则不动，太大则全部被拒）。VI 快速且赏心悦目，但在真实后验并非单峰高斯之处会悄然出错。这是现代贝叶斯深度学习中最具影响的一项不确定性。
@@T0@@Reading the picture.@@T1@@\n.src: Reading the picture. Grid is exact but exhaustive. MCMC histogram converges to grid but takes many samples (and the right step size: too small → no movement, too large → all rejections). VI is fast and pleasing-looking but quietly wrong wherever your true posterior isn't unimodal-Gaussian. This is the single most consequential uncertainty in modern Bayesian deep learning.

Bayesian linear regression — uncertainty.src: Bayesian linear regression — uncertainty that bows out

One last conjugate model with a famous picture. Linear
          regression with Gaussian prior on the weights and Gaussian
          observation noise has a Gaussian posterior over weights, and
          a Gaussian posterior predictive at every input $x$:

Click anywhere to add a data point. The.src: Click anywhere to add a data point. The fit line and its uncertainty band recompute live. Notice the band: thin where you have data, fat where you don't. That is what honest uncertainty looks like, and it is exactly what Gaussian processes generalise.

Click to add a data point; right-click (.src: Click to add a data point; right-click (or shift-click) to remove. Solid blue: posterior mean. Shaded teal band: ±2 posterior-predictive σ.

@@T0@@The big takeaway.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@最重要的收获。@@T1@@
          不确定带告诉你模型在何处被允许出错。在你没有数据之处却给你一个点估计的模型，是在就其已知的东西撒谎。贝叶斯推断在你正确做数学的副作用中，免费给出了“我有多不确定？”这一问题的正确答案。
@@T0@@The big takeaway.@@T1@@\n.src: The big takeaway. The uncertainty band tells you where the model is allowed to be wrong. A model that hands you a point estimate where you have no data is lying about what it knows. Bayesian inference gives you the right answer to "how unsure am I?" for free, as a side effect of doing the math correctly.

Hierarchical models — partial pooling, t.zh: 层次模型——部分池化，贝叶斯的超能力
Hierarchical models — partial pooling, t.src: Hierarchical models — partial pooling, the Bayesian superpower

Suppose you have several related groups:.zh: 假设你有若干相互关联的组：许多站点、传感器、学校、患者、批次。每组都有一小堆观测。你可以每组各拟合一个模型（“不池化”），也可以对所有数据拟合一个模型（“完全池化”）。两者都以已知的方式出错。贝叶斯的修正是@@T0@@部分池化@@T1@@：一个层次先验，让每组拥有自己的均值，同时把离群者拉向全局均值。
Suppose you have several related groups:.src: Suppose you have several related groups: many sites, sensors, schools, patients, batches. Each has a small pile of observations. You can fit one model per group ("no pooling") or one model for everything ("complete pooling"). Both are wrong in known ways. The Bayesian fix is partial pooling: a hierarchical prior that lets each group have its own mean while pulling outliers toward the global mean.

$\\mu$ is the global mean; $\\tau$ is ho.zh: $\mu$ 是全局均值；$\tau$ 表示各组被拉向它的强度；$\theta_g$ 是组特有的均值。$\theta_g$ 的后验被收缩向 $\mu$，收缩量取决于 $\tau$ 与该组的数据量 $n_g$。
$\\mu$ is the global mean; $\\tau$ is ho.src:
$\mu$ is the global mean; $\tau$ is how strongly groups are
          pulled toward it; $\theta_g$ is the group-specific mean. The
          posterior of $\theta_g$ is shrunk toward $\mu$ by an amount
          that depends on $\tau$ and the group's data count $n_g$.

Eight groups along the x-axis. Black dot.zh: 沿 x 轴排列的八个组。黑点：观测值。大符号：各组的 MLE（橙色 ×）、部分池化后验均值（青色 ●），以及完全池化的全局均值（蓝色虚线）。观察随着 τ 减小，数据匮乏组的估计如何被拉向全局均值。
Eight groups along the x-axis. Black dot.src: Eight groups along the x-axis. Black dots: observations. Big symbols: per-group MLE (orange ×), partial-pool posterior mean (teal ●), and complete-pool global mean (blue dashed line). Watch the data-poor group's estimate pull toward the global mean as τ shrinks.

@@T0@@The shrinkage formula.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@收缩公式。@@T1@@
          对于高斯数据，第 $g$ 组的后验均值是一个加权平均：$\hat\theta_g = w_g \bar y_g + (1 - w_g)\,\mu,$ $\;w_g = \frac{n_g/\sigma^2}{n_g/\sigma^2 + 1/\tau^2}.$ $n_g$ 大或 $\tau$ 小 ⇒ 相信该组；$n_g$ 小或 $\tau$ 大 ⇒ 相信全局均值。部分池化@@T2@@逐组地@@T3@@在两个极端之间插值。
@@T0@@The shrinkage formula.@@T1@@\n.src: The shrinkage formula. For Gaussian data, the posterior mean of group $g$ is a weighted average: $\hat\theta_g = w_g \bar y_g + (1 - w_g)\,\mu,$ $\;w_g = \frac{n_g/\sigma^2}{n_g/\sigma^2 + 1/\tau^2}.$ Big $n_g$ or small $\tau$ ⇒ trust the group; small $n_g$ or big $\tau$ ⇒ trust the global mean. Partial pooling interpolates the two extremes per group.

Why this matters: data-poor groups borro.zh: 为何这很重要：数据匮乏的组从数据丰富的组借用力量，@@T0@@而无需@@T1@@被迫与它们保持一致。James 与 Stein（1961）证明：在均方误差意义下，该估计量优于各组的 MLE——在三维及以上，不池化可被证明是次优的。
Why this matters: data-poor groups borro.src: Why this matters: data-poor groups borrow strength from data-rich ones without being forced to agree with them. James & Stein, 1961, proved that this estimator dominates the per-group MLE in mean squared error — in three or more dimensions, no-pool is provably suboptimal.

@@T0@@\"Bayesian = subjective, frequenti.zh:
@@T0@@“贝叶斯派 = 主观，频率派 = 客观。”@@T1@@@@T2@@
              两者都要选取假设：频率派选取一个抽样模型与一套流程（显著性水平、估计量）；贝叶斯派选取一个抽样模型与一个先验。贝叶斯把假设显式化，这才是真正的差别。
@@T0@@\"Bayesian = subjective, frequenti.src:
"Bayesian = subjective, frequentist = objective."
Both pick assumptions: frequentists pick a sampling model and a procedure (significance level, estimator); Bayesians pick a sampling model and a prior. Bayes makes the assumption explicit, which is the actual difference.

@@T0@@\"With enough data the prior doesn.zh:
@@T0@@“数据足够多时先验就无所谓了。”@@T1@@@@T2@@
              对低维、可良好辨识的参数而言成立（第 2 步已具体展示）。但在高维模型、层次模型，或任何似然在某些方向上平坦的设定中都不成立——而现代深度学习大多如此。
@@T0@@\"With enough data the prior doesn.src:
"With enough data the prior doesn't matter."
True for low-dimensional, well-identified parameters (Step 2 made this concrete). False in high-dimensional models, hierarchical models, or any setting where the likelihood is flat in some directions — which is most of modern deep learning.

@@T0@@\"MCMC always converges to the tru.zh:
@@T0@@“MCMC 总会收敛到真相。”@@T1@@@@T2@@
              在无限样本的极限下，是的。但在有限链与糟糕的建议分布下（第 5 步），MCMC 会在单个峰中停留很久，返回一个自信却错误的直方图，还告诉你它已收敛。务必运行多条链。
@@T0@@\"MCMC always converges to the tru.src:
"MCMC always converges to the truth."
In the infinite-sample limit, yes. With finite chains and poor proposals (Step 5), MCMC spends a long time in a single mode, returns a confidently wrong histogram, and tells you it converged. Always run multiple chains.

@@T0@@\"VI is just a faster MCMC.\"@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@“VI 只是更快的 MCMC。”@@T1@@@@T2@@
              VI 本质上有偏：它返回你变分族中最近的那个成员，即便该族中没有任何成员看起来像真相。在多峰后验上，高斯 VI 拟合可能在第二个峰上给出零质量，却仍声称自己已经“收敛”。
@@T0@@\"VI is just a faster MCMC.\"@@T1@.src:
"VI is just a faster MCMC."
VI is fundamentally biased: it returns the closest member of your variational family, even if no member of the family looks like the truth. On multimodal posteriors a Gaussian VI fit can put zero mass on the second mode while still claiming to have "converged".

@@T0@@\"A Bayesian neural network is jus.zh:
@@T0@@“贝叶斯神经网络不过是带先验训练的网络。”@@T1@@@@T2@@
              先验是容易的部分。困难的部分是在 1 亿维的参数空间上获得一个校准良好的@@T3@@后验@@T4@@，而今天的 MCMC 与 VI 都做不到诚实地完成它。SGLD、Laplace 近似、深度集成与 SWAG 都是实用的折中——它们中没有一个是“贝叶斯答案”。
@@T0@@\"A Bayesian neural network is jus.src:
"A Bayesian neural network is just one trained with a prior."
The prior is the easy part. The hard part is getting a calibrated posterior over a 100M-dimensional parameter space, which neither MCMC nor VI does honestly today. SGLD, Laplace, deep ensembles, and SWAG are practical compromises — none of them is "the Bayesian answer".

@@T0@@\"Bayesian inference is overkill i.zh:
@@T0@@“如果你只想要一个点估计，贝叶斯推断是大材小用。”@@T1@@@@T2@@
              后验@@T3@@均值@@T4@@对任意损失都能最小化均方误差；MAP 则最小化 0–1 损失。二者常常不同，而假装 MAP 是正确的概括方式所毁掉的论文，比过拟合还多。
@@T0@@\"Bayesian inference is overkill i.src:
"Bayesian inference is overkill if you only want a point estimate."
The posterior mean minimises mean-squared error for any loss; the MAP minimises 0–1 loss. They're often different, and pretending the MAP is the right summary has cost more papers than overfitting has.

Where this lives in your research.zh: 这套框架在你的研究中处于何处
Where this lives in your research.src: Where this lives in your research

Three places the Bayesian frame buys you.zh: 贝叶斯框架能在三处给你带来具体而非审美上的收益：
Three places the Bayesian frame buys you.src:
Three places the Bayesian frame buys you something concrete
          rather than aesthetic:

@@T0@@Calibrated uncertainty in deployed.zh:
@@T0@@部署模型中的校准不确定性。@@T1@@
            一个在分布外会说“我不知道”的传感器模型，比一个到处都说“0.97”的模型更安全。可靠性图 + 温度缩放 + 深度集成能带你走完大半路程；完整的贝叶斯深度学习则是有原则的极限。
@@T0@@Calibrated uncertainty in deployed.src: Calibrated uncertainty in deployed models. A sensor model that says "I don't know" off-distribution is safer than one that says "0.97" everywhere. Reliability diagrams + temperature scaling + deep ensembles get you most of the way; full Bayesian deep learning is the principled limit.

@@T0@@Hierarchical models for sparse, st.zh:
@@T0@@面向稀疏、结构化数据的层次模型。@@T1@@
            患者、站点、传感器、语言、个体——凡是你拥有许多组、而每组只有少量观测之处，部分池化都远远胜过“每组一个模型”与“所有数据一个模型”。这是贝叶斯在处理具有区域结构的数据时的超能力。
@@T0@@Hierarchical models for sparse, st.src: Hierarchical models for sparse, structured data. Patients, sites, sensors, languages, individuals — anywhere you have many groups with few observations each, partial pooling beats both "one model per group" and "one model for all" by a lot. This is the Bayesian superpower for data with regional structure.

@@T0@@Inverse problems and physics-infor.zh:
@@T0@@逆问题与物理信息机器学习。@@T1@@
            能量分解、空气质量的源解析、卫星像元解混、睡眠分期估计——其中的未知量是高维潜变量，而前向模型只被部分已知。贝叶斯是逆问题的语言；其余一切都只是对它的近似。
@@T0@@Inverse problems and physics-infor.src: Inverse problems and physics-informed ML. Energy disaggregation, source apportionment for air quality, satellite pixel unmixing, sleep-stage estimation — the unknown is a high-dimensional latent and the forward model is partially known. Bayes is the language of inverse problems; everything else is an approximation to it.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n T.zh:
@@T0@@最后总结。@@T1@@
          后验是一个概率分布。要推理它并不需要新的数学——只需要耐心，计算贝叶斯法则右端的那个乘积。上面八个交互模块就是那一个乘积的八种版本。其余一切（MCMC、VI、GP、BNN）都是管道工程。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n T.src: Final takeaway. The posterior is a probability distribution. You don't need new math to reason about it — just patience to compute the product on the right side of Bayes' rule. The eight interactives above are eight versions of that one product. Everything else (MCMC, VI, GPs, BNNs) is plumbing.

meta.title: 一步步构建后验分布
meta.tagline: 先验 × 似然 = 后验——八个实时实验，把贝叶斯推断从公式变成直觉
meta.summary: 拖动一个高斯先验，在坐标轴上点击数据点，观察后验如何逐渐成形。随后进入共轭情形（Beta-二项硬币），把后验预测分布与 MAP 代入法区分开，在一个非共轭后验上让网格求值、MCMC 与变分推断同场竞速，最后以贝叶斯线性回归收尾——其不确定带在远离数据处向外张开，所有数值都由纯 JS 实时计算。
highlights: 拖动高斯先验、点击数据，实时观察后验如何收缩与偏移。
在一枚真实的 Beta-二项硬币上比较先验强度与样本量，看数据何时取胜。
比较 MAP 代入法狭窄的预测分布与完整的后验预测分布——二者之差正是忽略不确定性的代价。
在一个非共轭、多峰的后验上让网格求值、Metropolis MCMC 与高斯变分拟合同场竞速。
带不确定带的贝叶斯线性回归——不确定带恰在数据缺失处向外张开，这正是高斯过程显得诚实的原因。
